items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Florence called me. He said, what's your father's address?

ctx.x: See? I put on a guy like that. And the girl says, you look like a gentleman now. That's what you need. All right. So the kid said, well, after the show tomorrow, now this is the next day now. He says, we're going out. Why don't you go with me? All right. I goes on out with the kid. And the first thing we got ready to go, Florence called me. He said, what's your father's address? I said, why? He said, well, you know, when you go abroad, you know, we got to have a dress case and things happened.
